## Data study: VPS price per GB RAM / per vCPU
Across 28 verified VPS plans from 12 providers (checked through 2026-10-31), list price per GB of RAM ranges from $1.21/GB/mo (OVHcloud VPS-3) to $10.00/GB/mo (AWS Lightsail Linux 0.5 GB) — 8.3× apart; the median is $5.00/GB. Hetzner CX23 and Hetzner CX33 would rank lower per GB but are sold out as of 2026-10-31, so they are left out of these figures. Per vCPU, OVHcloud VPS-3 is cheapest at $2.42/vCPU/mo vs a $6.50 median. Intro prices hide renewal jumps of up to +85% (Hostinger VPS KVM 1).
- Page: https://vpsledger.pages.dev/study/vps-price-per-gb-ram
- CSV: https://vpsledger.pages.dev/api/study-vps-price-per-gb.csv

## Changes
- 2026-10-31 UpCloud (correction): Correction: the $3.50 UpCloud row was labeled “Developer 1 GB”, a plan UpCloud now lists as discontinued. Renamed to the orderable Starter 1 GB ($3.50, 250 Mbit/s, max 5 per customer), Premium 1 GB ($6) verified and Starter 4 GB / 2 vCPU ($14) added, all re-read from UpCloud’s global pricing page. UpCloud Simple Backup (+20%) is now counted when backups are on. Discontinued plans are never ranked or suggested. [https://upcloud.com/global/pricing/]
- 2026-10-31 Vultr (correction): Correction: our verdicts, rankings and savings figures left out Vultr’s published 20% backup fee while the tables on the same pages included it. Vultr vc2-2c-4gb was shown as $20.00/mo “with backups” (and $106/yr cheaper than DigitalOcean); the true cost is $24.00/mo and the gap is $57.60/yr. Affected 19 pages. One fee policy now applies everywhere (every fee we hold is counted in tables, verdicts, rankings, widget and calculator), Vultr backup (20%) and overage ($0.01/GB) and Hetzner backup (20%) are now verified from official docs, and a build check fails if any verdict price differs from its own table. [https://docs.vultr.com/support/platform/billing/how-much-does-it-cost-to-enable-automatic-backups]
- 2026-10-31 Hetzner (availability): Re-checked: all 8 Cost-Optimized plans (CX23, CX33, CX43, CX53, CAX11, CAX21, CAX31, CAX41) are marked “not available” (“This product is currently unavailable. Please check back later.”). Cost-Optimized is listed for eu-central NBG1/HEL1 only. [https://www.hetzner.com/cloud/cost-optimized]
- 2026-10-31 Hetzner (correction): Correction: VPSLedger’s “Are you overpaying?” check, calculator and guides had suggested switching to Hetzner CX23/CX33 although Hetzner lists them as unavailable since our 2026-10-26 check. They are now labeled “Sold out” and “EU only” and are no longer suggested as switch targets; savings figures were recomputed from orderable plans only. [https://www.hetzner.com/cloud/cost-optimized]
- 2026-10-30 OVHcloud (correction): Corrected VPS-1/2/3 list prices to no-commitment monthly $5.35/$10.00/$14.50 (was 12-mo upfront $4.54/$8.50/$12.32 shown as monthly). 12-mo prepay kept as promo_mo. Source: OVH US public catalog API. [https://api.us.ovhcloud.com/v1/order/catalog/public/vps?ovhSubsidiary=US]
- 2026-10-30 Hetzner (availability): CX23 and CX33 re-confirmed currently unavailable on Hetzner cost-optimized / cloud pages (badge: Currently not available). [https://www.hetzner.com/cloud/cost-optimized]
- 2026-10-26 Hetzner (availability): CX23 (€5.99/mo) shown as “not available” / currently unavailable in listed locations. [https://www.hetzner.com/cloud/cost-optimized]
- 2026-10-26 Hostinger VPS (promo): KVM 1 promo $6.49/mo on 24-month term; renews at $11.99/mo. [https://www.hostinger.com/vps-hosting]
- 2026-10-26 DreamHost (promo): Stack 4 $8.99/mo for first 3 months, then $15.99/mo. [https://www.dreamhost.com/hosting/vps/]
- 2026-10-26 OVHcloud (lineup): “VPS 2027” range listed, VPS-1 from $4.54/mo (2 vCore, 4 GB). [https://www.ovhcloud.com/en/vps/]
- 2026-10-26 Linode / Akamai (transfer): G8 and GPU plans do not include bundled transfer; older plans include 0–20 TB. [https://www.linode.com/pricing/]
- 2026-10-26 Hostinger VPS (promo): KVM 2 promo $8.79/mo on 24-month term; renews at $14.99/mo. [https://www.hostinger.com/vps-hosting]
